The lodge

Rooms of cedar
and wool, one long
table by the fire.

St. Peter Hotel sits on the Cedars Main Road, at the foot of Lebanon's oldest ski resort. Guests come for the slope outside the door and stay for the dining hall — a bar, a hearth, and a table that fills with skiers trading stories over bread and wine. Rooms are simple, warm, and always heated properly; the kind of place where nobody complains about the Wi-Fi because nobody's looking at their phone.

Accommodation

Rooms built for
après-ski.

Wood-panelled twins and triples with real radiators, plaid wool bedding, and a curtain heavy enough to sleep through the mountain light. Free breakfast, free Wi-Fi, and air conditioning for the summer months.

Restaurant & bar

Bread, wine, and
a fire that doesn't quit.

The dining hall is the heart of the hotel — a stocked bar, table service, and a hearth set into stone. Breakfast is on us every morning.

Table service, mountain hours.

Long dinners of local wine and fresh bread, served at a table close enough to the fire to dry your gloves.

  • Free breakfast, every morning
  • Full bar with table service
  • Room service on request
  • Locally sourced & organic ingredients where possible
École de ski

The slope starts
at the front steps.

Ski lessons, and a sled run for the kids — all a short walk from the lobby, whatever the weather is doing.

Our instructors take beginners and groups out onto the open slope right behind the hotel.

03 321 496 — call the École de Ski desk directly to book lessons, or rent any equipment of your choice.
